private_key_boundary: externally injected private key held only by the Journal attestation authority; never persisted by this module
framing: strict UTF-8 domain + LF, then each field as UTF-8-byte-length decimal + ':' + exact bytes + ';'; no Unicode normalization and no null fields

rich_owner_statement.nested_receipt_rule: the Journal-owned owner-receipt framing SHA-256 is signed as journal_receipt_sha256

independent_worker_wire_correlation.journal_rule: Journal never parses, reconstructs, signs, or imports the Worker wire contract; it binds only the lowercase SHA-256 of the exact persisted Worker receipt UTF-8 bytes found in the durable WORKER_DRAINED payload
independent_worker_wire_correlation.supervisor_rule: Supervisor independently verifies the raw Worker wire, hashes those exact bytes, verifies this Journal rich wire, and requires the two scopes, deployment facts, drain identity, and worker_receipt_wire_sha256 to match
independent_worker_wire_correlation.key_separation_rule: after both independent proofs verify, Supervisor rejects equal normalized Worker and Journal SPKI SHA-256 identities

issuance_invariants: caller cannot supply journal head, checksum, file identity, entry range, entry-set digest, quarantine state, recovery state, owner receipt or Journal signatures
Journal reloads and recomputes the selected command entry set and complete head from the held durable journal file descriptor
the same OS-level writer lease used by append is held throughout issuance
device/inode or volume/file-index identity, length, bytes, head and state-artifact set must be identical before and after signing
any quarantine, stale append intent, concurrent append, link/reparse path, replacement, corruption, missing key, state change or expiry fails closed
